entry.title: New: dsh-strata
entry.summary: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher. Exact install spec: github:jsdvjx/dsh-strata. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
